summary: Aspen Insurance Holdings Ltd., a wholly owned subsidiary of Sompo International, filed a Form 6-K on May 29, 2026, announcing quarterly dividends on its three series of perpetual non-cumulative preference shares (5.625% AHL PRD and AHL PRE, and 7.00% AHL PRF). The dividends are payable July 1, 2026 to holders of record June 15, 2026, with per-share amounts of $0.3516, $0.35156, and $0.4375, respectively. This is a routine dividend declaration and press release, not a special situation. No transaction, strategic review, or corporate action is involved. There are no deal terms to report.
